fact.en: The lithosphere is Earth's rigid outer layer, made of the crust and the upper part of the mantle.
fact.tl: Ang lithosphere ay ang matigas na panlabas na layer ng Earth, na binubuo ng crust at itaas na bahagi ng mantle.
fact.bis: Ang lithosphere mao ang gahi nga panggawas nga layer sa Earth, nga gilangkuban sa crust ug sa taas nga bahin sa mantle.

cards.illustration: A cross-section of Earth showing the thin crust and upper mantle labeled as the lithosphere.

fact.en:
Why does oceanic crust sink while continental crust floats higher?

Oceanic crust is thinner but denser, so it bends downward more easily, while continental crust is thicker but less dense, so it rides higher.
fact.tl:
Bakit lumulubog ang oceanic crust habang mas mataas ang continental crust?

Ang oceanic crust ay manipis pero mas siksik, kaya mas madali itong yumuko pababa, samantalang ang continental crust ay makapal pero hindi gaanong siksik, kaya mas mataas ito.
fact.bis:
Nganong ang oceanic crust molubog samtang ang continental crust mas taas?

Ang oceanic crust nipis apan mas dasok, mao nga mas dali kini moyukbo paubos, samtang ang continental crust baga apan dili kaayo dasok, mao nga mas taas kini.

cards.illustration: A side-by-side comparison of a thick continental crust floating high and a thin oceanic crust sitting lower.

fact.en: Convection currents in Earth's interior are the slow, circling movements of hot mantle rock that push the lithospheric plates.
fact.tl: Ang convection currents sa loob ng Earth ay ang mabagal, paikot na paggalaw ng mainit na mantle rock na tumutulak sa mga lithospheric plate.
fact.bis: Ang convection currents sa ilawom sa Earth mao ang hinay, nagtuyok nga paglihok sa init nga mantle rock nga nagtulod sa mga lithospheric plate.

cards.illustration: A cutaway of Earth showing hot rock rising, cooling, and sinking in a circular loop beneath a plate.

fact.en: Plate Tectonic Theory explains that Earth's lithosphere is broken into large and small plates that move slowly and constantly.
fact.tl: Ipinaliliwanag ng Plate Tectonic Theory na ang lithosphere ng Earth ay hati-hati sa malalaki at maliliit na plate na mabagal at tuluy-tuloy na gumagalaw.
fact.bis: Ang Plate Tectonic Theory nagpasabot nga ang lithosphere sa Earth nabahin ngadto sa dagko ug gagmay nga mga plate nga hinay ug padayon nga naglihok.

cards.illustration: A globe with puzzle-like pieces of lithospheric plates slowly moving in different directions.

fact.en: A divergent boundary forms where two plates move apart, creating tension that lets magma rise and make new seafloor.
fact.tl: Nabubuo ang divergent boundary kung saan naghihiwalay ang dalawang plate, na lumilikha ng tension na nagpapataas ng magma at gumagawa ng bagong seafloor.
fact.bis: Ang divergent boundary maporma kung diin ang duha ka plate nagbulag, nga naghimo og tension nga magpataas sa magma ug maghimo og bag-ong seafloor.

cards.illustration: Two plates pulling apart with magma rising between them to form new seafloor.

fact.en: A mid-ocean ridge is a long underwater mountain chain that forms at a divergent boundary between two oceanic plates.
fact.tl: Ang mid-ocean ridge ay isang mahabang underwater na hanay ng bundok na nabubuo sa divergent boundary sa pagitan ng dalawang oceanic plate.
fact.bis: Ang mid-ocean ridge usa ka taas nga underwater nga kabukiran nga maporma sa divergent boundary tali sa duha ka oceanic plate.

cards.illustration: An underwater mountain chain rising along a crack where two oceanic plates pull apart.

fact.en: A continental rift valley is a lowland that forms when a continent is pulled apart at a divergent boundary.
fact.tl: Ang continental rift valley ay isang mababang lupain na nabubuo kapag ang isang kontinente ay hinihila palayo sa divergent boundary.
fact.bis: Ang continental rift valley usa ka ubos nga yuta nga maporma kon ang usa ka kontinente gibira palayo sa divergent boundary.

cards.illustration: A wide valley with steep sides forming where a continent is splitting apart.

fact.en: A convergent boundary forms where two plates move toward each other, causing one plate to bend downward or both plates to crumple.
fact.tl: Nabubuo ang convergent boundary kung saan naglalapit ang dalawang plate, na nagiging sanhi ng pagyuko pababa ng isang plate o pagkunot ng dalawang plate.
fact.bis: Ang convergent boundary maporma kung diin ang duha ka plate nagpaduol sa usag usa, nga maoy hinungdan nga ang usa ka plate moyukbo paubos o ang duha ka plate magkunot.

cards.illustration: Two plates pushing toward each other, with one plate bending down beneath the other.

fact.en:
What happens when an oceanic plate meets a continental plate?

The denser oceanic plate bends downward into the mantle in a process called subduction, where it melts and forms magma.
fact.tl:
Ano ang nangyayari kapag nagtagpo ang oceanic plate at continental plate?

Ang mas siksik na oceanic plate ay yumuyuko pababa sa mantle sa prosesong tinatawag na subduction, kung saan ito natutunaw at bumubuo ng magma.
fact.bis:
Unsa ang mahitabo kon magtagbo ang oceanic plate ug continental plate?

Ang mas dasok nga oceanic plate moyukbo paubos sa mantle sa proseso nga gitawag og subduction, diin kini matunaw ug magporma og magma.

cards.illustration: An oceanic plate bending downward into the mantle beneath a continental plate.

fact.en: Oceanic-continental convergence forms a continental volcanic arc and a deep trench parallel to the subduction zone.
fact.tl: Ang oceanic-continental convergence ay bumubuo ng continental volcanic arc at malalim na trench na kahanay ng subduction zone.
fact.bis: Ang oceanic-continental convergence magporma og continental volcanic arc ug lawom nga trench nga kahanay sa subduction zone.

cards.illustration: A chain of volcanoes on a continent with a deep trench offshore where an oceanic plate subducts.

fact.en: Oceanic-oceanic convergence forms an island volcanic chain parallel to a trench, with the older, denser plate subducting.
fact.tl: Ang oceanic-oceanic convergence ay bumubuo ng island volcanic chain na kahanay ng trench, kung saan ang mas luma at mas siksik na plate ang sumusubduct.
fact.bis: Ang oceanic-oceanic convergence magporma og island volcanic chain nga kahanay sa trench, diin ang mas karaan ug mas dasok nga plate ang mosubduct.

cards.illustration: A curved chain of volcanic islands rising from the sea beside a deep trench.

fact.en:
Why are there no volcanoes when two continents collide?

Both continental plates are thick and not dense enough to subduct, so they buckle upward and form mountain ranges instead.
fact.tl:
Bakit walang bulkan kapag nagbanggaan ang dalawang kontinente?

Parehong makapal at hindi gaanong siksik ang dalawang continental plate para mag-subduct, kaya kumukunot sila pataas at bumubuo ng mga hanay ng bundok.
fact.bis:
Nganong walay bulkan kon magbangga ang duha ka kontinente?

Ang duha ka continental plate baga ug dili kaayo dasok aron mo-subduct, mao nga mokunot kini pataas ug magporma og mga kabukiran.

cards.illustration: Two thick continental plates colliding and crumpling upward into a tall mountain range.

fact.en: A transform fault boundary forms where two plates slide past each other, creating cracks and fault valleys.
fact.tl: Nabubuo ang transform fault boundary kung saan dumudulas ang dalawang plate sa isa't isa, na lumilikha ng mga crack at fault valley.
fact.bis: Ang transform fault boundary maporma kung diin ang duha ka plate modailos sa usag usa, nga maghimo og mga crack ug fault valley.

cards.illustration: Two plates sliding horizontally past each other with a visible crack along the boundary.

fact.en: The San Andreas Fault in California is a famous transform fault boundary where the Pacific Plate and North American Plate slide past each other.
fact.tl: Ang San Andreas Fault sa California ay isang kilalang transform fault boundary kung saan ang Pacific Plate at North American Plate ay dumudulas sa isa't isa.
fact.bis: Ang San Andreas Fault sa California usa ka ilado nga transform fault boundary diin ang Pacific Plate ug North American Plate modailos sa usag usa.

cards.illustration: A map view of California showing the San Andreas Fault line where two plates slide past each other.

fact.en: Earthquakes occur at divergent and convergent plate boundaries because the moving plates release tremendous energy as they interact.
fact.tl: Nagkakaroon ng mga lindol sa divergent at convergent plate boundaries dahil naglalabas ng napakalaking enerhiya ang gumagalaw na mga plate habang nag-uugnayan ang mga ito.
fact.bis: Adunay mga linog sa divergent ug convergent plate boundaries tungod kay ang naglihok nga mga plate nagpagawas og hilabihan ka dako nga enerhiya samtang kini mag-interact.

cards.illustration: Shaking ground near a plate boundary with jagged lines showing released energy.

fact.en:
How does new seafloor form at a divergent boundary?

Magma rises from the mantle, cools and solidifies at the surface, creating new oceanic crust.
fact.tl:
Paano nabubuo ang bagong seafloor sa divergent boundary?

Umaakyat ang magma mula sa mantle, lumalamig at tumitigas sa surface, na lumilikha ng bagong oceanic crust.
fact.bis:
Giunsa pagporma ang bag-ong seafloor sa divergent boundary?

Ang magma mosaka gikan sa mantle, mobugnaw ug mogahi sa surface, nga maghimo og bag-ong oceanic crust.

cards.illustration: Magma rising through a gap between two plates and hardening into new seafloor.

fact.en: A divergent boundary is also called a constructive boundary because it builds new oceanic crust.
fact.tl: Ang divergent boundary ay tinatawag ding constructive boundary dahil bumubuo ito ng bagong oceanic crust.
fact.bis: Ang divergent boundary gitawag usab nga constructive boundary tungod kay naghimo kini og bag-ong oceanic crust.

cards.illustration: A divergent boundary with new crust forming between two separating plates.

fact.en: A convergent boundary is also called a destructive boundary because oceanic crust is destroyed as it melts in the mantle.
fact.tl: Ang convergent boundary ay tinatawag ding destructive boundary dahil nasisira ang oceanic crust habang natutunaw ito sa mantle.
fact.bis: Ang convergent boundary gitawag usab nga destructive boundary tungod kay ang oceanic crust malaglag samtang matunaw kini sa mantle.

cards.illustration: An oceanic plate melting into the mantle at a convergent boundary.

fact.en: The Philippine Plate moves toward the Eurasian Plate at a convergent boundary.
fact.tl: Ang Philippine Plate ay gumagalaw patungo sa Eurasian Plate sa isang convergent boundary.
fact.bis: Ang Philippine Plate naglihok padulong sa Eurasian Plate sa usa ka convergent boundary.

cards.illustration: A map showing the Philippine Plate moving toward the Eurasian Plate.

fact.en:
How did the Himalayan mountain range form?

Two continental plates collided and buckled upward, forming the Himalayas without any subduction.
fact.tl:
Paano nabuo ang Himalayan mountain range?

Dalawang continental plate ang nagbanggaan at kumunot pataas, na bumuo sa Himalayas nang walang subduction.
fact.bis:
Giunsa pagporma ang Himalayan mountain range?

Duha ka continental plate ang nagbangga ug mokunot pataas, nga nagporma sa Himalayas nga walay subduction.

cards.illustration: Two continental plates colliding and pushing up the tall Himalayan mountains.

fact.en: The East African Rift is an example of a continental rift valley formed at a divergent boundary.
fact.tl: Ang East African Rift ay isang halimbawa ng continental rift valley na nabuo sa divergent boundary.
fact.bis: Ang East African Rift usa ka pananglitan sa continental rift valley nga naporma sa divergent boundary.

cards.illustration: A wide valley in Africa where the continent is slowly splitting apart.

fact.en: The boundary between the Nazca Plate and the South American Plate is a convergent oceanic-continental plate boundary.
fact.tl: Ang boundary sa pagitan ng Nazca Plate at South American Plate ay isang convergent oceanic-continental plate boundary.
fact.bis: Ang boundary tali sa Nazca Plate ug South American Plate usa ka convergent oceanic-continental plate boundary.

cards.illustration: A map showing the Nazca Plate subducting beneath the South American Plate.

fact.en: The Pacific Plate and Nazca Plate form a divergent boundary where they move apart.
fact.tl: Ang Pacific Plate at Nazca Plate ay bumubuo ng divergent boundary kung saan sila naghihiwalay.
fact.bis: Ang Pacific Plate ug Nazca Plate nagporma og divergent boundary diin sila nagbulag.

cards.illustration: A map showing the Pacific Plate and Nazca Plate moving away from each other.

fact.en: The South American Plate and African Plate form a divergent boundary, so South America is moving away from Africa.
fact.tl: Ang South American Plate at African Plate ay bumubuo ng divergent boundary, kaya ang South America ay lumalayo sa Africa.
fact.bis: Ang South American Plate ug African Plate nagporma og divergent boundary, mao nga ang South America nagpalayo sa Africa.

cards.illustration: A map showing South America and Africa separated by a widening ocean.

fact.en: The boundary between the Australian Plate and African Plate is a divergent boundary.
fact.tl: Ang boundary sa pagitan ng Australian Plate at African Plate ay isang divergent boundary.
fact.bis: Ang boundary tali sa Australian Plate ug African Plate usa ka divergent boundary.

cards.illustration: A map showing the Australian Plate and African Plate moving apart.

fact.en: The boundary between the Pacific Plate and Antarctic Plate is a divergent boundary.
fact.tl: Ang boundary sa pagitan ng Pacific Plate at Antarctic Plate ay isang divergent boundary.
fact.bis: Ang boundary tali sa Pacific Plate ug Antarctic Plate usa ka divergent boundary.

cards.illustration: A map showing the Pacific Plate and Antarctic Plate moving away from each other.

fact.en: The Eurasian Plate and North American Plate form a divergent boundary in the North Atlantic Ocean.
fact.tl: Ang Eurasian Plate at North American Plate ay bumubuo ng divergent boundary sa North Atlantic Ocean.
fact.bis: Ang Eurasian Plate ug North American Plate nagporma og divergent boundary sa North Atlantic Ocean.

cards.illustration: A map showing the Eurasian and North American plates separating in the North Atlantic.

fact.en: The boundary between the Pacific Plate and Australian Plate is a convergent boundary.
fact.tl: Ang boundary sa pagitan ng Pacific Plate at Australian Plate ay isang convergent boundary.
fact.bis: Ang boundary tali sa Pacific Plate ug Australian Plate usa ka convergent boundary.

cards.illustration: A map showing the Pacific Plate and Australian Plate moving toward each other.

fact.en: The boundary between the Eurasian Plate and the Philippine Plate is a convergent boundary.
fact.tl: Ang boundary sa pagitan ng Eurasian Plate at Philippine Plate ay isang convergent boundary.
fact.bis: Ang boundary tali sa Eurasian Plate ug Philippine Plate usa ka convergent boundary.

cards.illustration: A map showing the Eurasian Plate and Philippine Plate moving toward each other.

fact.en: A deep-sea trench forms at a subduction zone where an oceanic plate bends downward into the mantle.
fact.tl: Nabubuo ang deep-sea trench sa subduction zone kung saan yumuyuko pababa ang oceanic plate sa mantle.
fact.bis: Ang deep-sea trench maporma sa subduction zone diin ang oceanic plate moyukbo paubos sa mantle.

cards.illustration: A deep underwater trench forming where an oceanic plate bends downward.

fact.en: A continental volcanic arc is a chain of volcanoes on a continent that forms parallel to a trench at an oceanic-continental convergent boundary.
fact.tl: Ang continental volcanic arc ay isang hanay ng mga bulkan sa isang kontinente na nabubuo kahanay ng trench sa oceanic-continental convergent boundary.
fact.bis: Ang continental volcanic arc usa ka laray sa mga bulkan sa usa ka kontinente nga maporma kahanay sa trench sa oceanic-continental convergent boundary.

cards.illustration: A chain of volcanoes on a continent parallel to a deep ocean trench.

fact.en: An island volcanic chain is a row of volcanic islands that forms parallel to a trench at an oceanic-oceanic convergent boundary.
fact.tl: Ang island volcanic chain ay isang hilera ng mga volcanic island na nabubuo kahanay ng trench sa oceanic-oceanic convergent boundary.
fact.bis: Ang island volcanic chain usa ka laray sa mga volcanic island nga maporma kahanay sa trench sa oceanic-oceanic convergent boundary.

cards.illustration: A curved row of volcanic islands rising from the sea beside a deep trench.

fact.en:
What are the three main types of plate boundaries?

Divergent boundaries where plates move apart, convergent boundaries where plates move toward each other, and transform fault boundaries where plates slide past each other.
fact.tl:
Ano ang tatlong pangunahing uri ng plate boundaries?

Divergent boundaries kung saan naghihiwalay ang mga plate, convergent boundaries kung saan naglalapit ang mga plate, at transform fault boundaries kung saan dumudulas ang mga plate sa isa't isa.
fact.bis:
Unsa ang tulo ka pangunang klase sa plate boundaries?

Divergent boundaries diin ang mga plate nagbulag, convergent boundaries diin ang mga plate nagpaduol sa usag usa, ug transform fault boundaries diin ang mga plate modailos sa usag usa.

cards.illustration: Three simple diagrams showing plates moving apart, together, and sliding past each other.
